plan: My goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid, I want to bid strategically to win while keeping my payment low. A common strategy in this type of auction (Vickrey auction) is to bid your true value. This ensures that if you win, you never pay more than your value, and you win whenever your value is higher than the second-highest bid. Given this is the first round and I have no history to learn from, bidding my true value is the safest and theoretically optimal strategy.
